title: Risky Kubernetes pod security (escalate) — review required
description: A pod spec weakens isolation: allowPrivilegeEscalation: true (escalate). Privileged mode, host namespaces, writable roots, and root users each move workloads toward node equivalence. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms necessity or enforces the restricted standard.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of namespace trust.
